request.prompt: A dim garden shed at dawn, a man on a chain. A solo accordion plays a slow, sad French waltz phrase that keeps faltering and stopping halfway, over a low sustained cello drone and the faint creak of wood; a few soft plucked double-bass notes. Melancholy, tender, uneasy, very sparse, 60 bpm in three-four time, no percussion, no climax. Instrumental, loops cleanly.
